document.abstract: Maison de Radio-Canada, in Montreal, has been constructed to consolidate four television services and nine radio services of the Canadian Broadcasting Corp. into one broadcast center. The center is located on a 25-acre (10.1-hectare) site. It contains 25 radio studios of varying size and seven color TV studios with two more built in shell for possible future use. Facilities include TV master control, presentation studios, telecine, kinerecording, videotape recording, film processing, dubbing, screening and viewing facilities.
